findings.assessment: Only the visible selected-schmear row and outgoing-contact icon change. Shared cashier rendering also shows grams in other supported modes; no catalog, price, request payload, contact formatter, link target/rel, gate, payment or order effect changes.

Pack/combo entry resets schmearSize to120; standalone selection preserves120/180/240. Always displaying the selected size corrects the missing optional-pack/combo detail without inventing a size. The journey assertions inspect rendered product rows, verify exactly one expected size, and verify removal clears the visible row.

Inline18x18 vector removes reliance on an installed arrow glyph. aria-hidden and focusable=false keep it decorative and out of the keyboard sequence, while the existing text preserves the accessible link name. currentColor preserves inherited contrast; existing flex/gap rules still apply. No conflicting generic SVG CSS was found. Actual geometry/readability remains a browser check.

The diff does not change interception ordering, external-origin/API/non-GET/HEAD/redirect/WebSocket blocking or service-worker restrictions. inquiry continues to inspect WA href only and never clicks it. No added provider request or order submission path.

Waiting for finite animations before capture avoids sampling the cashier entry opacity; screenshot animations are disabled, overflow and completed opacity are asserted, and SVG geometry and visible grams are checked. These additions strengthen checks while preserving both closed and enabled routes.
